from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single cash balance entry extracted from a financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the document")
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year end of the balance (e.g. 2022)")
    balance_amount: float | None = Field(description="The cash and cash equivalents balance amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the balance (e.g. USD)")
    balance_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written (e.g. 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    statement_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the balance sheet (e.g. December 31, 2022)")
    source_statement: str | None = Field(description="The type of financial statement (e.g. 'Consolidated Balance Sheets')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
